mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below its 5-year moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals economic weakness and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month industrial production growth rate below 0.5% signals weakening supply chain activity and reduced corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO month-over-month growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals imminent Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Weak payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2%) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE > previous month) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation-low rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) creates policy uncertainty as the Federal Reserve faces a dilemma, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.
